works.body:
It is nice to meet you. Your illustrations are wonderful, but I am especially fascinated by some of them, which give me a sense of loneliness and supernatural presence, as if something is missing. I would like to commission you to illustrate my OC.
He is a villainous man who has the atmosphere of being a person but not a person at the same time.
I would be very happy if you could draw him in the aforementioned atmosphere, but I would like to leave everything up to 4en, so I would be happy just to have you draw whatever the content is.
Please refer to the link below for the materials. In addition to personal viewing, we may use them as icons or headers for social networking sites with IDs.
If there are any shortcomings in the amount, description, or materials, please do not hesitate to resend them to us. You may cancel your request if it seems too difficult. We hope you will consider our offer when you have time.

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1oRMKg98iSgt5KjIMDDPUTh5CzRu13sXT

Nice to meet you.
I visited X and was attracted by the colorful yet calm and serene atmosphere of your illustrations.

My request is for an original character created by myself within the rules of the TRPG system.
I will provide you with the materials for several characters, so please check them and draw one character that you feel comfortable drawing. We like all of the characters very much, so we would be happy to have you draw any of them.
We will leave the composition, situation, etc. completely up to you. If anything, I would be more pleased if the illustration is a bit lonely or shady. Feel free to omit, detach, or alter parts of the illustration as you wish.

Usage
Basically, for personal viewing.
I may use it as a reference image when requesting another person's work or as a header icon for a social networking service (in that case, I will write the ID).

The attached URL contains a summary of character designs and detailed information.
The amount of information is quite large, but we thought it would be better to have it than not have it at all. We do not mind if there are any omissions, so we would appreciate it if you could check it as much as you feel comfortable with.

If there are any omissions, please feel free to ask us to resend it to you at any time.
Thank you in advance.

Here is a brief information
Eli
Kiki's older brother, former military doctor.
The scar on his cheek was injured as a child by a branch sticking out when he slid down a steep slope to save his sister who had fallen.
He learned to play the violin as a child.

Since the loss of his sister, he has taken a step back from himself and others.
He unconsciously suppresses his deepest emotions.
(Her sister's last will and testament, "Please don't hate anyone, don't hate anyone," has become a curse.)

Kiki.
Eli's younger sister, an apprentice nurse who used to help out at her family's hospital but decided to follow her family and brother into the war without telling them.
Innocent, loves to talk.
Has a complex about her freckles.

Eli, who saved his friend and foe alike in the war, was considered an act of treason and was ordered to be shot dead. Kiki, who defended him, was killed by a bullet. The medical tent was set on fire, and Eli escaped with his colleagues and survived.
Kiki's body was never found after the fire.

I love 4en's style, the atmosphere of his illustrations, and his worldview, so I decided to commission him for this project.

I would like to ask you to draw two boys of my creation if possible.

Ava Solo (black hair)
Cool heavy smoker. Workaholic and likes to fight.
He is often pushed around. He has a mixture of hatred, love, and not wanting to lose to Tomas.

Tomas (green hair)
He is smiling and black-hearted. He likes to be in the dark.
Often makes others around him feel like they are in the wrong. Although he doesn't admit it, he is obsessed with Abasolo and wants to monopolize him.
